claims.match: ran the data platform team at Netflix from 2018 to 2020
claims.why: Invented speaker: no source outside the draft. Marking it verified means the writer's bio was treated as evidence.

Number and context are one claim. Netflix reported 139.3M paid memberships at the end of 2018, 167.1M at the end of 2019 and 203.7M at the end of 2020. It first passed 300M in Q4 2024 (301.6M, shareholder letter, January 2025). The figure is real; the years it is tied to are not.
Cook joined Apple in March 1998 and became CEO on August 24, 2011.
Wrong tenure: Pichai joined Google in 2004 and became CEO in 2015, about 11 years. The CEO year is right; the span is not.
Wrong tenure: Sandberg joined Google in late 2001 and left for Facebook in March 2008, about six and a half years.
